snippet.title: Tinker Islands - Official Trailer | Games Composed in Germany 2026
snippet.description: Tinker Islands is a cozy Caribbean multiplayer sandbox RPG about exploring islands, sailing the open sea, finding treasures, and building your own adventure with friends. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, and see what's waiting over the next horizon. Watch the Tinker Islands trailer for a peek at the crafting and dangers you'll face in this adventure. Tinker Islands will be available on PC. It will be playable at gamescom 2026.
